title: Control operators
blurb: The big idea before the cards.

lines.caption: Every amateur transmission has one licensed person in charge. That person is the control operator.
lines.label: the person in charge

lines.caption: The station licensee, whose license covers the station, picks the control operator. Both of them are responsible.
lines.label: chosen by the licensee

lines.caption: The control operator's own license class decides which frequencies the station may use.
lines.label: their license, their limits

lines.caption: The control point is wherever the control operator does the job, not where the antenna stands.
lines.label: the control point

lines.caption: You may run any station from far away through a link, such as the internet. That is remote control.
lines.label: remote control

lines.caption: A repeater runs itself under automatic control. Even so, it still has a control operator.
lines.label: automatic control
